rule.name: CopyMethodDropsField
rule.message: This copy (a copy constructor, clone, toBuilder, copy, copyOf, rebuild or duplicate) copies most fields of the class but never reads or sets one of them, so the copy silently gets the default value and a setting is lost only on the code paths that copy the object. Copy every field: .shardId(this.shardId).tracker(this.tracker), or this.tracker = other.tracker. An exception fits when the field is meant to start fresh: mark it transient, or make it a lock, cache, counter or listener list.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassDeclaration[@RegularClass = true()] [empty(ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = ('EqualsAndHashCode', 'Data', 'Value', 'Builder', 'SuperBuilder')])] /ClassBody/(ConstructorDeclaration[@Arity = 1] | MethodDeclaration) [let $c := ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1], $m := ., $fields := $c/ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[not(@Static = true())][count(VariableDeclarator) = 1] [not(pmd-java:modifiers() = ('transient', 'volatile'))] [not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final' and VariableDeclarator/@Initializer = true())] [empty(ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = ('Exclude', 'Transient', 'XmlTransient', 'JsonIgnore')])] [empty(ClassType[@SimpleName = ('Logger', 'Log', 'Lock', 'ReentrantLock', 'ReadWriteLock', 'Semaphore', 'Thread', 'AtomicInteger', 'AtomicLong', 'AtomicBoolean', 'AtomicReference', 'LongAdder')])] [not(matches(VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, '^(cache|lock|log|logger|listener|listeners|mutex|memo|lazy|derived|computed|counter|executor|semaphore|callback|hash)|(Cache|Lock|Logger|Listener|Listeners|Mutex|Memo|Lazy|Derived|Computed|Counter|Executor|Semaphore|Callback|Hash)'))] [not(matches(VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, '^(id|modCount|version|dirty|created.*|closed|isClosed|finished|started|stopped|initialized|done|terminated|disposed|released|destroyed)$|^(temp|tmp|scratch)|(Temp|Tmp|Temporary|Scratch)'))] /VariableDeclarator/VariableId, $fieldNames := $c/ClassBody/FieldDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, $derived := function($n) { exists($c/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[@Visibility = ('private', 'package')] //AssignmentExpression[*[1][(self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess) and @Name = $n]]) or exists($c/ClassBody/ConstructorDeclaration//AssignmentExpression [*[1][(self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess) and @Name = $n]] [*[2]/descendant-or-self::*[self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess] [@Name = $fieldNames[. != $n]] [not(@Name = ancestor::ConstructorDeclaration/FormalParameters/FormalParameter/VariableId/@Name)]]) }, $cap := function($n) { concat(upper-case(substring($n, 1, 1)), substring($n, 2)) }, $accessors := function($n) { ($n, concat('get', $cap($n)), concat('is', $cap($n)), concat('set', $cap($n)), concat('with', $cap($n))) }, $touches := function($body, $n) { exists($body//(VariableAccess | FieldAccess)[@Name = $n]) or exists($body//MethodCall[@MethodName = $accessors($n)]) }, $isCopy := (self::ConstructorDeclaration and FormalParameters/FormalParameter/ClassType[@SimpleName = $c/@SimpleName]) or (self::MethodDeclaration and not(@Abstract = true()) and ((@Name = 'clone' and @Arity = 0) or ((@Name = ('toBuilder', 'copy', 'copyOf', 'rebuild', 'duplicate') or matches(@Name, '^with.*Copy$')) and ClassType[@SimpleName = $c/@SimpleName or ends-with(@SimpleName, 'Builder')]))), $params := FormalParameters/FormalParameter/VariableId/@Name, $opaque := exists(Block//ArgumentList/ThisExpression) or exists(Block//(MethodCall[not(@MethodName = ('requireNonNull', 'checkNotNull', 'notNull'))] | ConstructorCall)/ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $params]) or exists(Block//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'clone'][SuperExpression]) or exists(Block//ExplicitConstructorInvocation[@This = true()]) or exists(Block//ConstructorCall[ArgumentList[@Size ge 3]]), $candidates := $fields[not($derived(@Name))], $touched := $candidates[$touches($m/Block, @Name)] return $isCopy and not($opaque) and count($candidates) ge 3 and count($candidates) - count($touched) = 1 and 4 * count($touched) ge 3 * count($candidates)]
